title: 格斗

content_zh:
连胜试过自己的体质。力量, 低等。弹跳力, 一般。柔韧性, 僵硬。在对战上, 可取的身体素质大概就是, 视力和反应力。
体质可以加强, 但是视力却很难。捕捉对方的攻势，肌肉变动，以及各处细节。说是视力, 更准确地说应该是眼力。
连胜自己有着丰富的作战经验和预警直觉，而这身体或许还未形成条件反射，但是大脑已经足够及时应对, 这特有赖于本身出色的反应能力。
“连胜”从天资上来讲, 可以说是非常优秀了。
当然，对方的资质肯定也非常优秀。连胜还得靠技巧。
对手朝她做了个手势, 询问她准备好了没。连胜摆好架势, 也和他勾勾手指。
对面见状, 直接冲过来就是一记直拳。
显然他也没将连胜放在心上, 有意识地避开了她眼睛与鼻子处的危险位置, 冲着她的侧脸过来。因为有所收敛, 所以出拳速度不快。
连胜瞳孔微缩，脚步稍退，让对方拳头堪堪擦过自己的鼻尖。
对面抡了个空, 闪过一丝诧异, 但没有停顿，顺势转身改成飞踢。
付教官准备叫停，他觉得差不多就到此为止了，实力悬殊可以一招定乾坤。却见连胜已经下蹲，又躲过了他的飞踢。
似乎在对方出手之前，她已经做出了应对。
付教官连表情都没来得及收起，声音卡在喉咙里，只是眉毛无意识地一挑。
其实连胜不是在对方出手前应对，而是在对方出手的时候才应对。他肢体的扭转程度，脚步的站位，丝毫没有掩饰，一眼就可以看出他下一步的招式。
从他轻敌的时候开始，已经宣判他的结果。
连胜唇角轻抿，蹲下后接了一招扫堂腿。
那一扫却不是贴着地面朝对方的脚板过去，而是在靠近的时候，稍稍上抬，最后踢在了对方的小腿上。
对方尖叫一声，直直后倒，抱住了自己的小腿，冷汗顿下。
他觉得下半身几乎麻木，只有刚刚被踢中的地方，一阵剧烈的疼痛迟缓地传入大脑。
他还没来得及说话，连胜又出现在他的视线内。

那学生对上她的眼神，脸色瞬间发白，恐惧之情难以抑制地从心底升起。来不及抬手去挡，已经忘了此刻该有什么反应。就见对方一指点在他的肩膀处。
又是一阵剧痛，几乎半身麻木。
从来没有过这种体验，四肢神经仿佛被剥夺，脑海中闪过一个念头，那惊骇的心情便再也忍不住。
惨叫声从他口中溢出，接连不绝。害怕连胜再次出手，以此来吸引教官注意。
连胜已经一言不发地退到后面，揉着手旁观。
两位教官脸色顿变，一起围了过来。
周围同学齐齐惊呼起身，往那边张望。
刚刚事情发生的太快，他们根本没回过神来。连胜那边是一招制胜？还有别有隐情？
这男生唇色发白，眼睛微凸，呼吸不畅。不知道是吓得还是痛得，但这反应显然不会是装的。
教官急忙道：“怎么样？哪里不舒服？”
他发现自己的动作不再灵活，甚至有些难以控制。跟着问道：“我的手！我手怎么了！”
教官伸手去摸，并没有摸到什么。
男生艰难抬起另一手，颤抖地指向连胜。
众人又一次齐齐望向她。
连胜挑眉。
付教官质问：“你做了什么？”
连胜什么也没做。只是打中他的两个穴道而已。
小腿处的足三里穴，击中后会下肢麻木。以及肩膀最上处的肩井穴，击中后半身麻木。
这两处都属于人体经脉中的三十六要穴，所以击打会有疼痛感。但是并没有生命危险，也是按摩针灸中的重要穴位。
哦？这么简单的中医都不知道的吗？而且这反应也太夸张了，这辈子没腿麻过吗？

连胜刚想解释，付教官想到以前的旧案，立马脸色一黑，吼道：“你身上带了什么？公平竞争下使用非法武器，太卑鄙了！”
连胜表情一变。她非常不高兴。
虽然她性格有点恶劣，但是卑鄙这样的指控，她不接受。
连胜冷声道：“你也想来试试吗？”
付教官挽起袖子：“我劝你赶紧坦白，我是你的教官，别逼我动手。”
连胜站着没动，付教官气势汹汹，也没在怕她。就那么大步向前。
待他走近，连胜忽然弯下腰，一个弓步，一拳打在付教官的腹部。

content_en:
Streak tried his own physique. Strength, inferiority. Jumping ability, average. Flexibility, stiffness. In battle, the desirable physical qualities are probably vision and reflexes.
Physical fitness can be strengthened, but vision is difficult. Capture the opponent's offense, muscle movements, and every detail. Said to be vision, it should be more accurate to say that it is eyesight.
Lian Sheng himself has rich combat experience and early warning intuition, and his body may not have formed a conditioned reflex yet, but his brain is enough to respond in a timely manner, which relies on his excellent reaction ability.
In terms of talent, "Streak" can be said to be very good.
Of course, the other party's qualifications must also be very good. Winning streaks also depend on skill.
The opponent gestured to her, asking if she was ready. Lian Sheng got ready and hooked his fingers with him.
When the opponent saw this, he rushed over and delivered a straight punch.
Obviously, he didn't take the winning streak to heart, and consciously avoided the dangerous position of her eyes and nose, and came towards her side face. Because of some restraint, the punch speed is not very fast.
Lian Sheng's pupils shrank slightly and he stepped back slightly, allowing the opponent's fist to barely graze the tip of his nose.
The opponent's swing was empty, and there was a flash of surprise, but without stopping, he turned around and changed to a flying kick.
Instructor Fu was about to stop. He felt that it was almost over. The huge disparity in strength could make the difference with one move. But he saw that Lian Sheng had already crouched down and dodged his flying kick.
It seemed that she had already responded before the other party took action.
Instructor Fu didn't even have time to put away his expression, his voice was stuck in his throat, and he just raised his eyebrows unconsciously.
In fact, the winning streak is not to deal with the opponent before he takes action, but to deal with it when the opponent takes action. The degree of twisting of his limbs and the position of his steps were not concealed at all, and his next move could be seen at a glance.
From the moment he underestimated the enemy, his outcome has been pronounced.
Lian Sheng pursed his lips slightly, squatted down and then swept Tang's legs with a move.
That sweep did not go towards the opponent's feet close to the ground, but when he got closer, he lifted up slightly and finally kicked the opponent's calf.
The other party screamed, fell straight back, hugged his calf, and broke out in a cold sweat.
He felt that his lower body was almost numb. Only where he had just been kicked, a sharp pain slowly passed into his brain.
Before he could speak, Streak appeared in his sight again.
When the student met her eyes, his face instantly turned pale, and fear uncontrollably rose from the bottom of his heart. It was too late to raise a hand to block it, and I had forgotten how to react at this moment. He saw the other party pointing at his shoulder.
There was another sharp pain, almost half of the body was numb.
I have never had this kind of experience before. The nerves in my limbs seemed to be deprived. A thought flashed in my mind, and I could no longer hold back the horror.
Screams escaped from his mouth one after another. Afraid of trying again in a winning streak to attract the instructor's attention.
Lian Sheng had already retreated to the back without saying a word, rubbing his hands and watching.
The expressions of the two instructors suddenly changed and they gathered around together.
The surrounding students all stood up in surprise and looked over.
What happened just now happened so fast that they didn't even recover. Is there a single move to win the winning streak? Any other secrets?
This boy's lips are white, his eyes are slightly bulging, and he has difficulty breathing. I don't know if it was fear or pain, but this reaction was obviously not fake.
The instructor hurriedly asked: "How are you? Where do you feel uncomfortable?"
He found that his movements were no longer flexible and even a little difficult to control. Then he asked: "My hand! What happened to my hand!"
The instructor reached out and touched, but didn't touch anything.
The boy raised his other hand with difficulty and pointed at Streak tremblingly.
Everyone looked at her again.
Streak raised an eyebrow.
Instructor Fu asked: "What did you do?"
The winning streak did nothing. It just hit two of his acupuncture points.
on the calfZusanli point will cause numbness in the lower limbs after being hit. And the Jianjing point at the top of the shoulder will cause numbness in the lower half of the body.
These two points are among the thirty-six important points in the human body’s meridians, so hitting them will cause pain. But it is not life-threatening, and it is also an important acupuncture point in massage and acupuncture.
oh? Don’t even Chinese doctors know about such a simple thing? And this reaction is too exaggerated. Have you never experienced numbness in your legs in your life?
Just as Lian Sheng was about to explain, Instructor Fu suddenly turned pale when he thought of the old case and shouted, "What did you bring with you? Using illegal weapons in fair competition is so despicable!"
Lian Sheng's expression changed. She was very unhappy.
Although she has a bit of a bad character, she doesn't accept the accusation of being despicable.
Lian Sheng said coldly: "Do you want to give it a try too?"
Instructor Fu rolled up his sleeves: "I advise you to confess quickly. I am your instructor. Don't force me to do anything."
Lian Sheng stood still, while Instructor Fu was aggressive and not afraid of her. Just stride forward.
As he approached, Lian Sheng suddenly bent down, took a lunge, and punched Instructor Fu in the abdomen.
